summary: Afterword: the author's background (retired at 40, returned 2-3 years as a star analyst, retired again), his blog since 2007 (蔡森-随势而为-技术分析) and TV/teaching work, entry into A-shares in 2014, and how he turned his stock-picking logic into screening software in 2001 because there were too many stocks to review by hand — software pre-screens long/short candidates, but experience is needed for the final judgement. The book has two parts: 12 long/short judgement methods, and their extension into practical application and trading strategy. The back cover (p246) summarises the selling points: swing trading with the trend, strict stops, 12 methods, stop-loss/take-profit planning, and using only volume-price with patterns rather than indicators.

rules.rule: Use software to pre-screen long/short candidates, then refine manually; experience is still needed for correct judgement.
rules.quote_zh: 让我可以利用程式中先作一次多空选股后，再作精选。虽然经过软件程式的帮助确实省却相当多的时间，但还是要靠自己的经验才能做出较正确的判断

rules.rule: Book structure: part 1 = 12 long/short judgement methods; part 2 = extension incl. practical application and trading strategy.
rules.quote_zh: 第一部分讲解12招的多空判断方法，第二部分，则是第一部分12招多空判断方法的延伸，包括实战运用及操作策略的说明。

rules.rule: Swing trading following the trend with strict stop-loss, so you don't need to watch the screen.
rules.quote_zh: 波段随势操作，严守停损→操作不需盯盘

rules.rule: No difficult indicators or complex rules — judge only with volume-price relationship combined with patterns.
rules.quote_zh: 不教困难的指标，更不使用复杂的交易法则，仅用量价关系配合型态做判断

rules.rule: Correct concepts and timing let you lose small and win big, accumulating considerable profit.
rules.quote_zh: 建立正确的观念，以及准确掌握时机，才能在实战中小赔大赚，累积出可观获利。

rules.rule: Stop-loss and take-profit planning is a core part of the method.
rules.quote_zh: 停损停利的规划解释→获利诀窍大公开

worked_examples.outcome: After the 4474 bottom the bull run twice exceeded 10000; stock count grew, prompting screening software in 2001.

quantifiable: Two-stage pipeline: mechanical long/short screen over the full universe, then discretionary/rule-based refinement — maps to QU100 screener + thesis.
Use only price/volume + pattern features (no oscillators) in detectors faithful to the book.
ambiguities: Afterword gives no trading parameters; back-cover claims (e.g. '29年的投资经验') are marketing text.
Page 245 is book page 230; p246 is the back cover (ISBN 978-7-5454-4764-4, 定价 68.00元).
